label: Same profile witness underived from the two support bridges and Kant identification (inference)
rule: Rigid profile identity, the two support bridges and well-founded support exclude a self predecessor
meaning: Weaker sibling of the same-witness argument: the same five other inputs, with no contingent ground of the necessary and no novel necessary support in place of necessary-predecessor lifting. A putative supporter of the actual exemplar at an admitted world is necessary (no contingent ground), hence most real and the exemplar itself (Kant identification and numerical uniqueness); the exemplar exists actually, so no novel necessary support moves its self-support edge to the actual world, contradicting well-founded actual support. No actual reflexivity, excluded middle or frame axiom is used. Support is the supplied relation, not automatically efficient cause. Establishes no premise.
